title: Ribosome Architecture and the Molecular Basis of Translation
method: Unicode lexical count of final stored HTML p.teaching-prose text; excludes headings, figures, captions, tables, questions, answers, revision, references and UI. Visible article total includes visible SVG labels and expanded answers; excludes SVG title/desc and diagram controls.

comparator.method: Comparison with repository-recorded QA; comparable depth is supported by distinct narrative paragraphs and scope coverage rather than a file size quota.

scientific_checks: Mapped all assigned roadmap microtopics to revised CSIR Unit 3.C and archived MP SET 2024 Unit 3.C; visually inspected relevant syllabus pages.
Reviewed sedimentation dimensions and buoyancy/friction derivation; bacterial, archaeal, cytosolic, mitochondrial and chloroplast composition; ion-dependent subunit association.
Reviewed antiparallel codon pairing, initiator P-site placement, classical and hybrid A/P/E states, aminoacyl versus peptidyl ester chemistry, N-to-C extension and energy distinctions.
Cross-checked Noller 1992 biochemical evidence, Nissen 2000 substrate-contact structures, Ogle 2001 decoding, Moazed/Noller hybrid states, historical polysome observations and organellar caveats.

Reviewed polysome occupancy versus completion flux, runoff and elongation stalling, inhibitor targets, experimental controls and mischarging versus decoding. Rewrote 13 Part C questions with plausible competing hypotheses and explicit controls.

arithmetic_checks.values: 11.2 and 14 µm/s; 30S; 1.5-fold; occupancy 6, 12, 5 and 10; packing 30 and 24; flux 0.2/s; local velocity 12 µm/s. Additional runoff reasoning 10 and 40 s checked manually.

academic_self_review.method: Internal second-pass author review, not external independent peer review. Deductions for simplified schematics, incomplete full-paper access, untested browser interactions and absence of external examiner validation.

limitations: Not externally peer-reviewed; references verified through accessible sources/abstracts, not all full papers.
MP SET comparator is the archived 2024 syllabus, not a current original-host PDF.
HTML and SVG source checks only; browser/mobile controls, visual rendering and comprehensive accessibility were not tested interactively before commit.
Authorized out-of-order development: earlier unpublished curriculum neighbors remain unlinked.
